facts: Marlin separates report visibility from row-download permissions.
A Viewer can open reports and change on-screen filters. An Analyst can also export CSV only if the workspace owner enabled exports.
An Owner can enable exports but does not automatically have Analyst permission.
Filtered exports allow at most 5,000 rows, including exactly 5,000. At 5,001 or more the whole download is blocked with the specified message; rows are never silently truncated.
A partial file might incorrectly appear complete for a monthly total.
